description: This file contains the implementation of HomeController, a class responsible for managing the state and data fetching logic for the home view in a Flutter application. It handles loading the home feed, managing continue watching items, reacting to cache updates, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage the state of the home feed screen. It handles fetching data, cache updates, and provides observable state for the UI.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the home feed data from the repository, manages loading/error states, and initiates loading of continue watching items after successful fetch.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches recent watch history, retrieves detailed content items, and updates the continue watching list.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the continue watching list after playback progress is saved.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Reloads the home feed and continue watching items from the cache, reacting to cache buster events.
